title: Hayati Pro Max Blue Razz Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Blue Razz Lemonade blends tangy Blue Raspberry with fizzy Lemonade for a bold and refreshing vape. The Blue Raspberry brings a sweet-tart confectionary-like flavour, while the Lemonade adds a light citrus sparkle—creating a balanced fruit drink-inspired vape with a lively, zesty kick. Blended with nicotine salts for a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine delivery, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG mix ensures discreet vapour and consistent flavour performance. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
